title: Smoked Sausage Tagine
description: A hearty North African-inspired stew made with smoked sausage, tender vegetables, and aromatic spices. Perfect for a cold winter night.
instructions: Heat the oil in the bottom of a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the sausage and set aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the potato, tagine spice mix, diced tomatoes, and chicken broth to the pot.
Stir to combine, then return the sausage to the pot.
Bring the stew to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, until the potato is tender, about 30 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with parsley and serve hot.
